task.question: What was the average closing price of ticker 'ALKEM' during the month of March 2026 (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 inclusive)?

result.question: What was the average closing price of ticker 'ALKEM' during the month of March 2026 (2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31 inclusive)?
result.cited_sql:
SELECT AVG(p.close) as avg_close
FROM prices p
JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
WHERE i.ticker = 'ALKEM'
  AND p.date >= '2026-03-01'
  AND p.date <= '2026-03-31'
